# What was done

Implemented the **group view** requested 2026-08-14 and shipped it to the
Windows test box. The overlay now opens (by default) with one dotted box per
first-char label group instead of every pill; typing a group char reveals only
that group's points labeled by their second char; the second char fires the
click — 2 keystrokes, same coverage as the previous full-label view
(29×29 = 841), far less on screen at once.

Design was confirmed with the user before implementation: fire at the 2nd
label (no recursive drilling for now); boxes derive from the existing label
groups (no new point geometry); drill view is the default with `<leader>p`
toggling to the full-label view per-session.

# Key results

- `GroupViewService` (pure, tested): `IsGroupable` (all-`PointHint` + a 2-char
  label present) and `BuildGroupBoxes` (per-first-char union of member rects).
- `HintCanvas`: 4 new DPs; a dedicated dotted-box visual; level 2 renders
  prefix-stripped labels and hides non-matching hints regardless of
  `HideNonMatchingLabels`.
- `OverlayViewModel`: per-session groupability + boxes; `ToggleGroupView`
  (no-op in zone phases); `MatchLength` binding; leader case.
- Config: `GroupViewEnabled` (default true) + `GroupFontSize` (default 14,
  0 = follow `HintFontSize`), both hot-reload and in the Options dialog.
  `LeaderBindings` gained `p=GroupView` (code default AND shipped value).
- Defects caught during implementation (both fixed before commit): seeding the
  group-rect union with `default(Rect)` would stretch every box to the origin
  (`default(Rect)` is a valid degenerate rect at 0,0, not `Rect.Empty`);
  computing `_groupable` as `_groupViewOn && …` would have made the toggle
  one-way.
